about.lead: We are a market research operations company based in Greater Noida, India, and the team behind the Research Centric OPS platform. We help agencies, brands, startups, advertisers and panel companies collect data they can trust and turn it into decisions.
story: Research COPS began as a fieldwork and survey-operations partner for market research agencies. The work they need sounds simple and is hard to do well: find the right respondents, program the survey correctly, keep the fraud out and deliver on time.

Over time our clients asked us to do more: write the questionnaire, translate it into new markets, process the data and present what it means. We now run the full research lifecycle, either as a white-label team behind an agency or as the research partner for brands and startups without a research department.

Running hundreds of projects taught us where the time and margin really go: in the seams between tools. So we built Research Centric OPS, one platform where the RFQ, the quote, the script, the sample, the data and the report all live in the same project. Alongside it sits Opinion Genie, our own panel, working with a network of API-integrated partner panels.
about.note: Our name is our approach: Research Centric Ops. We put the research first, and run the operations behind it with the discipline of a well-run engineering team.

services.name: Questionnaire design
services.short: Surveys that measure the right thing and get finished.

services.featuresTitle: Designed around the decision you need to make
features: We start from the decision your team must make and tie every question to it.
Screeners that qualify the right people and filter out professional survey takers.
MaxDiff, Van Westendorp, conjoint-lite, NPS, brand funnels and concept tests.
We cut each survey to the shortest LOI that still answers your objectives, which protects data quality and budget.
Neutral wording, randomised lists and balanced scales reduce order and acquiescence bias.
Each questionnaire comes with a tab plan, so the results answer the questions you asked.
steps: Business objective, audience, hypotheses and how the results will be used.
A full questionnaire with logic notes and an LOI estimate, usually within 24 hours.
Two rounds of revisions with you. We flag any trade-offs between length and coverage.

faqs: Can you review a questionnaire we already wrote?
Yes. A questionnaire audit is a fixed-fee service. We send back tracked changes, the reason for each one, and a revised LOI estimate.
Do you design for mobile respondents?
Always. More than half of respondents now take surveys on a phone, so we avoid large grids and long lists.
Which methodologies do you support?
U&A, brand health, concept and ad testing, pricing (Van Westendorp, Gabor-Granger), MaxDiff, segmentation and customer satisfaction.
